patterns.name: check-then-act race
patterns.detail: 40 concurrent requests all read a value under the ceiling before any had written back. 40 were permitted.

patterns.name: post-hoc accounting
patterns.detail: Sequential, not even concurrent. The ceiling is checked against state that excludes the in-flight call, so a request approved with headroom to spare can still blow through it — real completion costs vary by an order of magnitude and are unknowable before the call.

patterns.name: best-effort recording
patterns.detail: Ledger recorded 0.00 while the provider billed 2.00. 40 write failures were swallowed. Enforcement is unbounded for as long as the store is down.

patterns.name: unpriced model fallback
patterns.mechanism: model missing from price table → cost 0.0
patterns.detail: All 40 calls passed the ceiling check at zero cost. Actual spend 2.00. The ledger believes it spent 0.00.
